limitations.note: The patch correctly holds `s3_d011` through invalid samples, but it also changes the valid-1 and invalid exits from `s4_d0110` to preserve overlap where the original and reference both return to idle.

The rolling-history oracle assumes every overlapping occurrence should match, so the exhaustive test endorses the extra transitions instead of checking that the original post-match behavior is preserved.
